player_prompt.intro:
Ku dhufte lakki qabamu Frozen Lake!

Ati bakka 'P' irratti grid irratti waamama.
 Mallattoolee grid:
  ' ' = Lakki qabamu (salphina irratti deemu)
  'H' = Hoola (kutee badhaadhu!)
  'G' = Galii (kun gahuun moo'adhu!)
  'P' = Bakka kee amma jirtu

Hojiin mijeessan: gara olii, gara gaditti, gara bitaafi, gara mirga (ykn w, a, s, d)
Barreessi hojii kee akkana: [up], [down], [left], [right] ykn [w], [a], [s], [d]

Galii: Gara jalqabaa (gara olii-bitaa) hanga galii (gara gaditti-mirga) tarkaanfachuu hoola kamittuu kuteen!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qindaa'ina dhiheenyaa mala. [up], [down], [left], [right] ykn [w], [a], [s], [d] kan tti fayyadamu.
invalid_move.unknown_action: Hojii hin beekamne '{action}'. ol, gadii, bitaa, mirgaa ykn w, a, s, d fayyadami.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Hoolaa keessatti arii! Tamsaasaan itti dhufee. Safaroota kee {pct}% tiin guutuun isaa eegale.
outcome.turn_limit: Safartu kee dhumate! Tapha dhumate. Ka'u gahuuf safartu kee {pct}% xumurate.
